name: swipe-deck
summary: A card stack you swipe left or right; the top card leans in 3D and stamps a label.
props: Fires when a card leaves, with "left" or "right".
Controlled top card; a fresh batch (first key changed) starts from the top on its own.
Fires once every card is gone.
Shown when the deck is empty.
Stamp shown while dragging; null hides it.
Cards visible behind the top one.
Throw the top card from a button, or bring the last one back; reset() starts again from the first card.
behavior: Drag the top card past the threshold or flick it to throw it off; a short drag springs back. A ref exposes swipe, undo and reset for buttons.
The card follows your finger, rotates and tilts in 3D, washes in the right or left colour and shows the stamp, while the next card rises.
Only the top card is exposed. It offers the right and left labels as accessibility actions, which throw the card that way.
